lifecycle_phases.trigger: H050_0 checkpoint: First passage where giveback from running maxMFE in incumbent regime R0 reaches >= 0.50 ATR.
lifecycle_phases.trade_direction: Counter-direction C = -D0 (where D0 is R0 regime direction).

lifecycle_phases.event: R1 confirmation: Incumbent regime R0 terminates at r0_end_ts and transitions to regime R1 (direction D1 = C).
lifecycle_phases.holding_policy: Position held through confirmation into R1.

lifecycle_phases.candidate: H050_1 opposing checkpoint: The first causal H050 checkpoint emitted during regime R1 (giveback >= 0.50 ATR from R1 running maxMFE).
lifecycle_phases.temporal_scope: Must occur between r1_start_ts and r1_end_ts with direction D1 = C.
lifecycle_phases.exit_execution: Next 1s bar open price following h050_1_ts. c1_exit_source = 'H050_1'.

lifecycle_phases.condition: If regime R1 terminates without emitting an H050 checkpoint (r1_end_ts reached without H050_1).
lifecycle_phases.fallback_exit: R2 confirmed flip: Exit at r1_end_ts / r2_start_ts upon confirmed opposite regime transition.
lifecycle_phases.exit_execution: Next 1s bar open price following r1_end_ts. c1_exit_source = 'R2_FALLBACK'.

exit_selection_order: 1. First causal H050_1 in R1 if present; 2. R2 flip exit at r1_end_ts if H050_1 absent.
